bio: The charm of Bouchot brings out the warmth of this stylish building dating back to 1934. Smiling sommelier and hostess Tessa provides excellent wine recommendations; meanwhile, in the kitchen, Bram expresses his love for Zeeland and classic French cuisine. On retro tableware, he serves up œufs meurette – soft-poached eggs in a sweet and intense red wine sauce with bacon and mushrooms – and crispy veal sweetbreads with hazelnuts and a sauce enriched with balsamic vinegar and spices. Quality ingredients speak for themselves in all their simplicity, thanks to the expertly made sauces. A new favourite spot for Brabant's bon vivants!...
